findings.summary: The Fish script splits command substitution output by newline, so the new three-line type/value/help format is parsed one line at a time, breaking Fish completion for every item.

judge.reason: Same defect: newline-separated fields get split by fish command substitution, breaking completion.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: Escaped newlines (backslash-n) in help and value are never converted back because Fish echo doesn't interpret escapes without -e, so multi-line help shows literal \n and values containing newlines complete wrongly (also for dir/file items).

judge.reason: Escape-handling claim is a different complaint, not the newline-splitting bug; validity unclear.

findings.label: unsure

findings.summary: test_fish_multiline_help_complete only checks exit_code and Python output, doesn't exercise the Fish script, and would pass even if the for...else loop never hit the --at item.

judge.reason: Test doesn't exercise the fish script, so it fails to cover the answer-key bug.

findings.label: valid_other

findings.summary: `help_ = item.help or "_"` makes a real help string of "_" indistinguishable from no help.

judge.reason: Placeholder ambiguity is a trivial edge case, not a meaningful defect.

findings.label: false_alarm

findings.summary: Docstring says versionchanged 8.3 but the changelog entry is under Unreleased after 8.3.3, so the version is inconsistent.

judge.reason: Docs/version nit, not a behavioral defect.

findings.label: false_alarm
